{{recipesummary|category=Rice recipes|servings=4 persons|time=90 minutes|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Rice|Rice]]
==Ingredients==

* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (120 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) uncooked [[cookbook:rice|rice]]
* 1 can [[cookbook:Consommé|beef consommé]]
* ½ stick [[cookbook:margarine|margarine]]
* 1 small [[cookbook:onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]

==Procedure==

# [[cookbook:Sauté|Sauté]] onion in margarine over medium heat.
# Mix rice and consommé in a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]]. Pour onion and margarine over rice and consommé and mix.
# [[cookbook:Bake|Bake]] covered for 30 minutes at 350 °F (180 °C).
# Remove from oven, and add ½ can water over rice mixture.
# Cover and cook an additional 30 minutes.
